description: This file defines a React component 'Profile' that manages user profile and preferences. It imports API functions for fetching and updating profile data, and uses the 'useToasts' component for notifications. The component handles loading state, form inputs for profile and preferences, and submits updates via API calls.

methods.name: onSaveProfile
methods.description: Handles profile form submission; updates profile via API and shows success toast.

methods.name: onSavePrefs
methods.description: Handles preferences form submission; updates preferences via API and shows success toast.
